teamNotifications.label: Team Notifications
teamNotifications.tooltip: Enter email addresses of team members who should receive campaign updates

shareAnalytics.label: Share Campaign Analytics with Team Members
shareAnalytics.tooltip: Allow team members to view campaign performance metrics and reports

description.label: Campaign Description
description.placeholder: Describe the campaign's goals, target audience, and key messages

status.label: Status
status.tooltip: To share the campaign link with Learners, please ensure the campaign status is set to Active.

initialLeadScore.label: Initial Lead Score
initialLeadScore.tooltip: A base score added to every lead captured through this campaign. Final score = initial score + calculated score (capped at 100).

postSubmit.description: What the respondent sees the moment this form is submitted. Prefilled from Settings → Lead Settings → Forms; changes here apply to this campaign only.

errors.instituteContextUnavailable: Institute context unavailable. Please refresh and try again.
errors.customFieldsMustBeArray: Custom fields JSON must be an array.
errors.customFieldsInvalidJson: Custom fields must be valid JSON.
errors.startDateInPast: Start date cannot be before today.

formAppearance.title: Form Appearance
formAppearance.description: How the public response form looks while it is being filled in — layout, colours and the wording around the fields. Applies to this campaign only.

formTemplate.title: Form Template
formTemplate.description: How the public form page looks when someone opens the link. Pick a look; your text and fields stay the same.

formText.title: Form Heading & Text
formText.description: The heading at the top of the public form (defaults to this list’s name) and the text above the fields — with left, centre or right alignment.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Label this list so reports can group its leads by tag, e.g. by state, course or channel. One value per tag.
tags.loadError: Couldn't load this list's tags. Saving will keep its current tags.

errors.invalidKey: Tag name "{{key}}" is not valid. Use up to 40 letters, numbers, spaces or underscores.
errors.duplicateKey: Tag "{{key}}" is used twice. A list can have one value per tag.
errors.valueTooLong: The value of "{{key}}" is too long. Use at most 60 characters.
errors.invalidValue: The value of "{{key}}" contains a line break or other control character.
errors.tooMany: A list can have at most 10 tags.
